facts.note: At nine, by the temple bell, Aurèle had everyone bring out watches. Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. Same timepiece and relation.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by his watch. He then went to the hall to fetch the cigar case from his coat. Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back.
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after he sat down again.

added.quote: I sat down again and lit a cigar, and the hall clock struck eleven a moment after I sat down again.
added.why: Places the lighting of a cigar after he sat down again and before the hall clock struck eleven. The sheet gives no event between sitting down and the strike, so this is a new order between two events in that window.
